THE DEMANDS OF PUBLIC OFFICE

Media attention, public scrutiny, high-pressure decision-making and balancing professional and personal responsibilities can all affect wellbeing and performance.

Tracey provides confidential support for politicians and their teams, creating a safe space to address challenges before they become barriers to performance. Working closely with the individual and their Chief of Staff, she helps ensure pressures are managed proactively. We also offer leadership programmes for political staff and office teams, self-led or facilitated.

SUPPORTING CHALLENGES SUCH AS

  • Media exposure
  • Press intrusion
  • Online scrutiny
  • High-pressure decision-making
  • Balancing personal and professional life
When leaders are supported, teams perform better. When teams perform better, public service is strengthened.
